FIELD.name: source_id
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Source identification number. The number is constructed as follows: 4 x 10^13 + process_id x 10^7 + source number in the image.

FIELD.name: process_id
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Process identification number

FIELD.name: scan_id
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Scan identification number

FIELD.name: plate_id
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Plate identification number

FIELD.name: archive_id
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Archive identification number

FIELD.name: solution_num
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Solution number within the process

FIELD.name: annular_bin
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Annular bin (1-9) where the source belongs (bin 1 is in the center, bin 9 is at the edge)

FIELD.name: dist_center
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Distance of the source from plate center

FIELD.name: dist_edge
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Distance of the source from plate edge

FIELD.name: sextractor_flags
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Flags given by SExtractor

FIELD.name: model_prediction
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Classification of the source as celestial (value close to 1) or artifact (value close to 0). The value is a prediction by a machine-learning algorithm.

FIELD.name: ra_icrs
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Right ascension of the source (International Celestial Reference System)

FIELD.name: dec_icrs
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Declination of the source (International Celestial Reference System)

FIELD.name: ra_error
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Error of the right ascension

FIELD.name: dec_error
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Error of the declination

FIELD.name: gal_lon
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Galactic longitude of the source

FIELD.name: gal_lat
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Galactic latitude of the source

FIELD.name: ecl_lon
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Ecliptic longitude of the source

FIELD.name: ecl_lat
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Ecliptic latitude of the source

FIELD.name: x_sphere
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Source x-coordinate on the unit sphere

FIELD.name: y_sphere
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Source y-coordinate on the unit sphere

FIELD.name: z_sphere
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Source z-coordinate on the unit sphere

FIELD.name: healpix256
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Source HEALPix number (nside=256, nested ordering)

FIELD.name: healpix1024
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Source HEALPix number (nside=1024, nested ordering)

FIELD.name: nn_dist
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Distance to the nearest neighbor among extracted sources

FIELD.name: zenith_angle
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Zenith angle of the source

FIELD.name: airmass
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Air mass (path length for light rays from a celestial source to pass through the atmosphere)

FIELD.name: natmag
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Calibrated magnitude of the source in the plate natural photometric system

FIELD.name: natmag_error
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Error estimate of the magnitude in the plate natural photometric system

FIELD.name: bpmag
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Calibrated magnitude of the source in the Gaia EDR3 BP (blue) passband

FIELD.name: bpmag_error
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Error estimate of the calibrated BP magnitude

FIELD.name: rpmag
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Calibrated magnitude of the source in the Gaia EDR3 RP (red) passband

FIELD.name: rpmag_error
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Error estimate of the calibrated RP magnitude

FIELD.name: natmag_plate
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Magnitude of the source in the plate natural photometric system, obtained through photometric calibration for the whole plate, without corrections

FIELD.name: natmag_correction
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Correction applied to the source magnitude in the plate natural photometric system

FIELD.name: natmag_residual
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Residual of the source magnitude in the plate natural photometric system after corrections, compared to the synthetic magnitude constructed from Gaia EDR3 photometry

FIELD.name: phot_range_flags
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Photometric range flags: 0 - source natmag is in the range of calibration stars; 1 - source natmag is brighter than the brightest calibration star; 2 - source natmag is fainter than the estimated faint limit of the plate

FIELD.name: phot_calib_flags
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Flag for photometric calibration stars: 0 - source is not a calibration star; 1 - source is a valid calibration star; 2 - source was found to be an outlier of the photometric calibration curve

FIELD.name: color_term
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Color term of the plate, characterizing color response of the emulsion and filter used. Color term 0 corresponds to the Gaia EDR3 RP passband, color term 1 corresponds to the BP passband. Values outside the 0...1 range are extrapolations.

FIELD.name: cat_natmag
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Magnitude of the source in the plate natural photometric system, RP+color_term * (BP-RP), based on the Gaia EDR3 catalogue

FIELD.name: gaiaedr3_gmag
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Gaia EDR3 G-magnitude of the matched source

FIELD.name: gaiaedr3_id
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Gaia EDR3 source_id of the matched source

FIELD.name: gaiaedr3_bp_rp
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Gaia EDR3 BP-RP color index of the matched source

FIELD.name: gaiaedr3_dist
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Angular distance in the sky plane between the source and the matched Gaia EDR3 source

FIELD.name: gaiaedr3_neighbors
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Number of Gaia EDR3 sources that are in the neighborhood of the source. The neighboring sources can be found in the source_xmatch table.

FIELD.name: match_radius
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Radius in the sky plane that was used to cross-match extracted sources with the Gaia EDR3 catalogue

FIELD.name: timestamp_insert
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Timestamp of insert

FIELD.name: timestamp_update
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Timestamp of last update

FIELD.name: pos
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: GIS index for (ra,dec)
